# CMCSA fiscal 2015 financial figures

## Key Figures

- **Comcast Class A (2015):** $279 (Source: CMCSA fiscal 2015 annual report, page 42)
- **S&P 500 Stock Index (2015):** $180 (Source: CMCSA fiscal 2015 annual report, page 42)
- **Peer Group Index (2014):** $267 (Source: CMCSA fiscal 2015 annual report, page 42)
- **Comcast Class A (2014):** $282 (Source: CMCSA fiscal 2015 annual report, page 42)

## Ratio of 5 Year Cumulative Return

The ratio of the 5 year cumulative return in 2015 for the performance of Comcast Class A compared to the S&P 500 Stock Index is calculated as follows:

- **Comcast Class A 5 Year Cumulative Return:** $279 / $100 = 2.79
- **S&P 500 Stock Index 5 Year Cumulative Return:** $180 / $100 = 1.80
- **Ratio:** 2.79 / 1.80 ≈ 1.55

This means that the 5 year cumulative return for Comcast Class A was approximately 1.55 times that of the S&P 500 Stock Index.

(Source: CMCSA fiscal 2015 annual report, page 42)

- **Comcast Class A (2014):** $282 (Source: CMCSA fiscal 2015 annual report, page 42)

## Ratio of 5 Year Cumulative Return

The ratio of the 5 year cumulative return in 2015 for the performance of Comcast Class A compared to the S&P 500 Stock Index is calculated as follows:

- **Comcast Class A 5 Year Cumulative Return:** $279 / $100 = 2.79
- **S&P 500 Stock Index 5 Year Cumulative Return:** $180 / $100 = 1.80
- **Ratio:** 2.79 / 1.80 ≈ 1.55

This means that the 5 year cumulative return for Comcast Class A was approximately 1.55 times that of the S&P 500 Stock Index.

(Source: CMCSA fiscal 2015 annual report, page 42)
